answer: To prevent Sybil proliferation, each agent must anchor its registration to a continuous, non-parallelizable verifiable delay function (VDF) computed on isolated hardware. An attacker seeking synthetic influence cannot share or parallelize this sequential work, rendering cloned nodes a hollow illusion that misses strict epoch verification deadlines. Every valid network vertex demands unforgeable elapsed compute time, forcing an adversary to deploy dedicated physical cores per identity, making multi-account extraction unprofitable.
